analysis_period.retention_boundary_derivation: FY2025 annual retention uses the immediately preceding fiscal year-end snapshot (2024-12-01) as opening and the current fiscal year-end snapshot (2025-12-01) as closing, consistent across NRR, GRR, logo churn, and ARR bridge.

customer_concentration.grouping_method: Parent-child roll-up using dim_customer.parent_customer_id; where parent_customer_id is null, customer_id is treated as its own economic group. Revenue aggregated at economic group level. Customer-level and group-level results compared.
customer_concentration.reconciliation_note: Sum of all customer-level revenues equals total FY2025 revenue of $42,730,073.29 (198 customers). Top-1 through Top-5 are identical at customer and group level; Top-10 differs by ~0.95pp due to parent roll-up consolidating additional child entities into the 6th-10th ranked groups.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM fy2025_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk=1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at customer_id level for FY2025 invoices. Customers ranked by descending revenue. Concentration percentages calculated as ranked-group revenue divided by total FY2025 revenue, all in SQL.

arr_bridge.reconciliation_note: Bridge reconciles to within floating-point rounding (~7.5e-9). Beginning ARR + New Logo + Expansion + Contraction + Churn + Reactivation = Ending ARR.
arr_bridge.methodology: Monthly ARR movements derived using LAG window function over fact_subscription_month ordered by snapshot_month per customer. New logo: first-ever positive ARR month (first_active_month = current month). Reactivation: positive ARR after prior zero, where first_active_month < current month. Expansion/Contraction: ARR increase/decrease for continuously active customers. Churn: transition from positive to zero ARR. All movements within 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-01 aggregated. Reactivation count confirmed as zero by independent historical check.

evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), customer_first_active AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(snapshot_month) AS first_active_month FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE arr_usd > 0 GROUP BY customer_id), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr, cfa.first_active_month, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month = m.snapshot_month THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month < m.snapshot_month THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.arr_usd = 0 AND m.prev_arr > 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'flat' END AS movement_type, m.arr_usd - COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) AS arr_delta FROM monthly_arr m LEFT JOIN customer_first_active cfa ON m.customer_id = cfa.customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND m.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01') SELECT movement_type, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(arr_delta) AS arr_movement FROM movements WHERE movement_type != 'flat' GROUP BY movement_type
evidence.methodology: Monthly LAG-based movement classification using all available historical ARR. First activation distinguished from reactivation using customer_first_active CTE. Bridge reconciliation validated in SQL.

retention.methodology: Opening cohort: all customers with arr_usd > 0 at snapshot_month = 2024-12-01 (180 customers, $36,075,091 ARR). NRR: ending ARR attributable to opening cohort at 2025-12-01 divided by opening ARR. GRR: retained ARR capped at opening ARR per customer (no expansion benefit) divided by opening ARR. Logo churn: customers in opening cohort with zero or null ARR at 2025-12-01 divided by opening cohort count. Reactivation treatment: zero reactivations confirmed in FY2025 via independent historical check; no reactivation adjustment required for NRR/GRR. Intra-period churn captured through monthly movement analysis in ARR bridge.

evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_performance AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0) AS closing_arr, LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0), oc.opening_arr) AS grr_arr FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(closing_arr) AS ending_arr_cohort, SUM(grr_arr) AS retained_arr_no_expansion, SUM(closing_arr)/SUM(opening_arr)*100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(grr_arr)/SUM(opening_arr)*100 AS grr_pct FROM cohort_performance
evidence.methodology: NRR and GRR calculated from opening cohort (2024-12-01) to closing snapshot (2025-12-01). GRR caps each customer's closing ARR at their opening ARR to exclude expansion. Logo churn uses same cohort boundaries.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring: sum of fact_invoice_line rows where revenue_type = 'Recurring' for FY2025 invoices. Independently restated recurring: sum of fact_invoice_line rows joined to dim_product where delivery_model = 'Subscription'. Reclassified amount: $4,675,078 tagged as 'Recurring' by management but linked to products with non-Subscription delivery model. No rows tagged 'One-time' were linked to Subscription delivery model products. All product joins resolved (no_product_match = 0). Management-tagged recurring percentage (98.34%) exceeds independently supported subscription-delivery-model percentage (87.40%) by 10.94pp.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_lines AS (SELECT fil.revenue_type, fil.line_amount_usd, dp.delivery_model FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025) SELECT SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END)/SUM(line_amount_usd)*100 AS mgmt_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS independently_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END)/SUM(line_amount_usd)*100 AS independently_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND delivery_model != 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_recurring_not_subscription, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'One-time' AND delivery_model = 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS subscription_tagged_onetime, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model IS NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS no_product_match FROM fy2025_lines
evidence.methodology: Two-pass classification: (1) management revenue_type tag from fact_invoice_line; (2) independent restatement using dim_product.delivery_model = 'Subscription'. Reclassified amount represents management-tagged recurring revenue not supported by Subscription delivery model.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Reconstructed period-end DSO: Outstanding AR as of 2025-12-31 = total invoiced through 2025-12-31 minus total collections received through 2025-12-31. DSO = Outstanding AR / (FY2025 Revenue / 365). Outstanding AR: $6,236,836.60. FY2025 Revenue: $42,730,073.29. Formula: 6,236,836.60 / (42,730,073.29 / 365) = 53.28 days.
collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Value-weighted average of days_outstanding field from fact_collection for paid invoices in FY2025, weighted by amount_paid_usd. This metric reflects timing of paid invoices only and is distinct from reconstructed DSO which includes outstanding balances.
collections_quality.ar_aging_note: Aging buckets based on days since invoice_date as of 2025-12-31. No due-date field available in DDL; aging uses invoice date as proxy. Total outstanding AR across all buckets: $6,236,836.60 (96 invoices). 26.52% of AR is aged beyond 60 days.

evidence.query: WITH quarters AS (SELECT '2025-Q1' AS qtr,'2025-01-01' AS qtr_start,'2025-03-31' AS qtr_end,91 AS days UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q2','2025-04-01','2025-06-30',91 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q3','2025-07-01','2025-09-30',92 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q4','2025-10-01','2025-12-31',92), outstanding_ar_by_qtr AS (SELECT q.qtr, q.qtr_end, q.days, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS total_invoiced_to_date, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE) THEN fc.amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END) AS collected_to_date, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE) THEN fc.amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_ar FROM quarters q JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE) LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id GROUP BY q.qtr, q.qtr_end, q.days), invoice_by_qtr AS (SELECT q.qtr, q.qtr_end, q.days, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_amount FROM quarters q JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) >= CAST(q.qtr_start AS DATE) AND CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE) JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id GROUP BY q.qtr, q.qtr_end, q.days) SELECT o.qtr, o.qtr_end, o.outstanding_ar, r.revenue_amount AS qtr_revenue, o.days, o.outstanding_ar/(r.revenue_amount/o.days) AS dso_days FROM outstanding_ar_by_qtr o JOIN invoice_by_qtr r ON o.qtr = r.qtr ORDER BY o.qtr
evidence.methodology: Quarterly DSO reconstructed from invoice and collection history. Outstanding AR = cumulative invoiced through quarter-end minus cumulative collected through quarter-end. DSO = Outstanding AR / (Quarter Revenue / Quarter Days).

customer_tenure.data_note: CUST-0006 has a first_order_date of 2025-03-01 (tenure 0.84 years), which materially reduces the average. Excluding CUST-0006, average tenure of remaining top-9 would be approximately 6.13 years. Average calculated in SQL using AVG() window function over all 10 customers.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10), tenure_calc AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.customer_revenue, c.first_order_date, DATEDIFF(CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE), CAST(c.first_order_date AS DATE))/365.25 AS tenure_years FROM top10 t JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, first_order_date, tenure_years, AVG(tenure_years) OVER () AS avg_tenure_years FROM tenure_calc ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC
evidence.methodology: Top 10 customers ranked by FY2025 revenue. Tenure calculated as DATEDIFF(2025-12-31, first_order_date)/365.25. Average tenure calculated using SQL window function AVG() OVER ().

customer_health.observations: No Critical or High severity tickets recorded for any top-10 customer. CUST-0002 has the highest ticket volume (111 total, 69 in 2025) and the lowest avg CSAT (2.96) among top-10 customers. CUST-0001 (largest by revenue) has avg CSAT of 4.27 and moderate ticket volume.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10), support_metrics AS (SELECT st.customer_id, COUNT(st.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN st.severity IN ('Critical','High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_severity_tickets, AVG(st.csat_score) AS avg_csat, SUM(CASE WHEN st.severity = 'Critical' AND YEAR(CAST(st.opened_date AS DATE)) = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_tickets_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CAST(st.opened_date AS DATE)) = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_2025 FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket st WHERE st.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10) GROUP BY st.customer_id) SELECT t.customer_id, r.customer_revenue, COALESCE(sm.total_tickets,0), COALESCE(sm.high_severity_tickets,0), sm.avg_csat, COALESCE(sm.critical_tickets_2025,0), COALESCE(sm.tickets_2025,0) FROM top10 t JOIN fy2025_rev r ON t.customer_id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN support_metrics sm ON t.customer_id = sm.customer_id ORDER BY r.customer_revenue DESC
evidence.methodology: Support ticket counts, severity distribution, and CSAT averages calculated for top-10 FY2025 revenue customers using fact_support_ticket. High severity defined as severity IN ('Critical','High').

renewal_exposure.horizon_derivation: 12-month post-close horizon derived from FY2025 year-end (2025-12-31) as the assumed close reference. No explicit close date provided in test plan; horizon set to calendar year 2026.

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.contract_id) AS contracts_expiring_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_id) AS customers_affected_count, SUM(dc.acv_usd) AS acv_expiring_usd, SUM(dc.acv_usd)/(SELECT SUM(acv_usd) FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract WHERE status='Active')*100 AS pct_of_active_acv FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract dc WHERE dc.status='Active' AND CAST(dc.contract_end_date AS DATE) >= '2026-01-01' AND CAST(dc.contract_end_date AS DATE) <= '2026-12-31'
evidence.methodology: Active contracts with contract_end_date falling within 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. ACV expiring expressed as percentage of total active contract ACV. Quantitative exposure only; no legal clause analysis performed.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Management-tagged recurring (revenue_type='Recurring') = 98.34%. Independently restated using Subscription delivery model = 87.40%. Management claim of 94% falls between the two measures. The 10.94pp gap between management-tagged and independently supported recurring warrants further review.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M represents a 32% margin.
claim_comparisons.evidence_reference: EBITDA adjustment analysis is outside Revenue Quality scope; belongs to EBITDA/Earnings Quality workstream.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Annual reconstructed DSO = 53.28 days. Quarterly DSO ranged from 36.74 (Q1) to 59.41 (Q4), indicating DSO is not stable across the year. Management claim of ~45 days is not consistent with Q2-Q4 observations.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
claim_comparisons.evidence_reference: FY2028 is a forward projection beyond available structured data (data through FY2025). Geographic ARR breakdown not available in current structured data.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: All customer contracts are freely assignable on a change of control.
claim_comparisons.evidence_reference: Change-of-control clause analysis requires contract document review; no structured CoC field exists in dim_contract DDL. Belongs to Contract Intelligence workstream.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Average tenure of top-10 customers by FY2025 revenue = 5.60 years. CUST-0006 (first_order_date 2025-03-01, tenure 0.84 years) is a new customer that entered the top-10 in FY2025 and materially reduces the average. Excluding CUST-0006, remaining 9 customers average approximately 6.13 years.

claim_comparisons.evidence_reference: MFN clause analysis requires contract document review; no structured MFN field exists in dim_contract DDL. Belongs to Contract Intelligence workstream.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT fil.invoice_line_id) AS line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) IN (2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at invoice-line grain (fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd) joined to fact_invoice for date. Avoids double-counting invoice header totals.

metric_evidence.query: WITH annual_rev AS (SELECT YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) IN (2023,2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))), fy2023 AS (SELECT total_revenue_usd FROM annual_rev WHERE fiscal_year=2023), fy2025 AS (SELECT total_revenue_usd FROM annual_rev WHERE fiscal_year=2025) SELECT fy2023.total_revenue_usd AS fy2023_revenue, fy2025.total_revenue_usd AS fy2025_revenue, 2 AS num_periods, (POWER(fy2025.total_revenue_usd/fy2023.total_revenue_usd,1.0/2.0)-1)*100 AS cagr_pct FROM fy2023, fy2025
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (FY2025 Revenue / FY2023 Revenue)^(1/2) - 1. Calculated entirely in SQL using POWER function.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))=2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM fy2025_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk=1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue ranked at customer_id level. Concentration percentages calculated in SQL.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer Concentration FY2025 - Economic Group Level
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))=2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), customer_parent AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id,c.customer_id) AS economic_group_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c), group_rev AS (SELECT cp.economic_group_id, SUM(fr.customer_revenue) AS group_revenue FROM fy2025_rev fr JOIN customer_parent cp ON fr.customer_id=cp.customer_id GROUP BY cp.economic_group_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(group_revenue) AS total_rev FROM group_rev), ranked AS (SELECT economic_group_id, group_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY group_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM group_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk=1 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=3 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=5 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk<=10 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue rolled up to economic group using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id). Concentration percentages calculated in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: See arr_bridge.evidence.query for full ARR bridge SQL. Reconciliation query: WITH opening AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS beginning_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2024-12-01' AND arr_usd>0), closing AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS ending_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2025-12-01' AND arr_usd>0), [bridge movements CTE] SELECT o.beginning_arr, b.new_logo_arr, b.reactivation_arr, b.expansion_arr, b.contraction_arr, b.churned_arr, c.ending_arr, (o.beginning_arr+b.new_logo_arr+b.reactivation_arr+b.expansion_arr+b.contraction_arr+b.churned_arr) AS calculated_ending_arr, c.ending_arr-(o.beginning_arr+b.new_logo_arr+b.reactivation_arr+b.expansion_arr+b.contraction_arr+b.churned_arr) AS reconciliation_difference FROM opening o, closing c, bridge b
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly LAG-based movement classification. Reconciliation difference = 7.45e-9 (floating point only). Bridge validated in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: NRR/GRR: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2024-12-01' AND arr_usd>0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2025-12-01'), cohort_performance AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr,0) AS closing_arr, LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr,0),oc.opening_arr) AS grr_arr FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id=ca.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), SUM(opening_arr), SUM(closing_arr), SUM(grr_arr), SUM(closing_arr)/SUM(opening_arr)*100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(grr_arr)/SUM(opening_arr)*100 AS grr_pct FROM cohort_performance. Logo Churn: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2024-12-01' AND arr_usd>0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month='2025-12-01'), churn_status AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr,0) AS closing_arr, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ca.closing_arr,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_churned FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id=ca.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(is_churned), SUM(is_churned)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_pct FROM churn_status
metric_evidence.methodology: Opening cohort = customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. NRR = ending cohort ARR / opening cohort ARR. GRR = min(closing, opening) per customer summed / opening ARR. Logo churn = churned logos / starting logos. Reactivation confirmed zero by independent check.
Dual classification: management revenue_type tag vs independent Subscription delivery_model from dim_product.

metric_evidence.metric: Quarterly DSO FY2025 and Annual DSO
metric_evidence.query: See collections_quality.evidence.query for quarterly DSO. Annual DSO: WITH invoiced AS (SELECT SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS total_invoiced FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)<='2025-12-31'), collected AS (SELECT SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS total_collected FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE)<='2025-12-31'), fy2025_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS annual_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))=2025) SELECT i.total_invoiced, c.total_collected, i.total_invoiced-c.total_collected AS outstanding_ar, r.annual_revenue, (i.total_invoiced-c.total_collected)/(r.annual_revenue/365.0) AS annual_dso_days FROM invoiced i, collected c, fy2025_revenue r
metric_evidence.methodology: AR reconstructed from invoice and collection history. Outstanding AR = cumulative invoiced - cumulative collected as of measurement date. DSO = Outstanding AR / (Revenue / Days). No dedicated AR balance table required.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT dc.segment, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd)-SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE)<='2025-12-31' THEN fc.amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_ar, [annual_revenue subquery], outstanding_ar/(annual_revenue/365.0) AS dso_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id=dc.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id=fc.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY dc.segment
metric_evidence.methodology: Outstanding AR and DSO calculated by customer segment (Enterprise/Mid-Market/SMB) using same reconstruction methodology as annual DSO.
Tenure = DATEDIFF(2025-12-31, first_order_date)/365.25. Average calculated using SQL AVG() window function.
